/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeInfoList : 레시피 정보 목록 페이징 및 조건 조회 */
SELECT R.RECIPE_SEQ , R.RECIPE_ID , R.RECIPE_TTL , R.DISH_NM , R.RECIPE_CN , R.COOKING_TIME , R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD , R.CATEGORY_CD , R.VIEW_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIKES L WHERE L.TGT_SEQ = R.RECIPE_SEQ) AS LIKE_CNT , U.USER_NM AS WRITER_NAME , R.FILE_GRP_ID , R.REG_DT FROM RECIPE R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.RECIPE_STATUS = '02'
AND R.CATEGORY_CD = #{categoryCd}
AND R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD = #{recipeDifficultCd}
AND ( R.RECIPE_TTL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR R.DISH_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INGREDIENT I WHERE I.RECIPE_SEQ = R.RECIPE_SEQ AND I.DEL_YN = 'N' AND I.INGRD_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM RECIPE_HASHTAG RH INNER JOIN HASHTAG H ON RH.HSTG_SEQ = H.HSTG_SEQ AND H.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE RH.RECIPE_SEQ = R.RECIPE_SEQ AND RH.DEL_YN = 'N' AND H.HSTG_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') ) )
AND R.REG_DT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 DAY'
AND R.REG_DT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 WEEK'
AND R.REG_DT >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
ORDER BY LIKE_CNT DESC, R.REG_DT DESC
ORDER BY R.VIEW_CNT DESC, R.REG_DT DESC
ORDER BY R.REG_DT DESC

/* RecipeMapper.selectTempRecipeList : 임시저장 레시피 목록 조회 */ SELECT R.RECIPE_SEQ , R.RECIPE_ID , R.RECIPE_TTL , R.DISH_NM , R.RECIPE_CN , R.COOKING_TIME , R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD , R.CATEGORY_CD , R.VIEW_CNT , 0 AS LIKE_CNT , U.USER_NM AS WRITER_NAME , R.FILE_GRP_ID , COALESCE(R.MDFCN_DT, R.REG_DT) AS REG_DT FROM RECIPE R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.RECIPE_STATUS = '01' AND R.RGTR_KEY = #{userKey} ORDER BY REG_DT DESC

/* RecipeMapper.retrieveRecipeInfo : 레시피 정보 상세 조회 */ SELECT R.RECIPE_SEQ , R.RECIPE_ID , R.RECIPE_TTL , R.DISH_NM , R.RECIPE_CN , R.COOKING_TIME , R.RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD , R.CATEGORY_CD , R.VIEW_CNT , ( SELECT COUNT(TGT_SEQ) FROM LIKES WHERE TGT_SEQ = R.RECIPE_SEQ AND TGT_TY = 'RECIPE' AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS LIKE_CNT , U.USER_NM AS WRITER_NAME , R.REG_DT , R.RECIPE_STATUS , R.OPEN_YN , R.FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE R INNER JOIN USERS U ON R.RGTR_KEY = U.USER_KEY AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.RECIPE_ID = #{recipeId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: /* RecipeMapper.insertRecipeInfo : 레시피 정보 등록 */ INSERT INTO RECIPE (RECIPE_ID, RECIPE_TTL, DISH_NM, RECIPE_CN, COOKING_TIME, RECIPE_DIFFICULT_CD, CATEGORY_CD, FILE_GRP_ID, RGTR_KEY, RECIPE_STATUS, OPEN_YN) VALUES (#{recipeId}, #{recipeTtl}, #{dishNm}, #{recipeCn}, #{cookingTime}, #{recipeDifficultCd}, #{categoryCd}, #{fileGrpId}, #{rgtrKey}, #{recipeStatus}, #{openYn})
mapper.select: /* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeIngredientList : 레시피 재료 목록 조회 */ SELECT INGRD_NM , INGRD_AMT , INGRD_UNT FROM INGREDIENT WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
/* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeStepList : 레시피 단계 목록 조회 */ SELECT STEP_NO , STEP_CN , FILE_GRP_ID FROM RECIPE_STEP WHERE RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY STEP_NO
mapper.insert: /* RecipeMapper.insertHashtag : 해시태그 마스터 등록 */ INSERT INTO HASHTAG (HSTG_ID, HSTG_NM, RGTR_KEY) VALUES (#{hstgId}, #{tagNm}, #{rgtrKey}) ON CONFLICT (HSTG_NM) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: /* RecipeMapper.selectRecipeHashtags : 레시피 해시태그 목록 조회 */ SELECT H.HSTG_NM FROM RECIPE_HASHTAG RH INNER JOIN HASHTAG H ON RH.HSTG_SEQ = H.HSTG_SEQ WHERE RH.RECIPE_SEQ = #{recipeSeq} AND H.USE_YN = 'Y' AND H.DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert: /* RecipeMapper.insertRecipeHashtag : 레시피 해시태그 매핑 등록 */ INSERT INTO RECIPE_HASHTAG (RECIPE_SEQ, HSTG_SEQ) VALUES (#{recipeSeq}, #{hstgSeq}) ON CONFLICT (RECIPE_SEQ, HSTG_SEQ) DO UPDATE SET DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.select: /* RecipeMapper.upsertLike : 좋아요 등록/수정 (UPSERT) */ INSERT INTO LIKES (TGT_SEQ, USER_SEQ, TGT_TY, CRET_DT, DEL_YN) VALUES ( #{tgtSeq} , (SELECT USER_SEQ FROM USERS WHERE USER_KEY = #{userKey} AND DEL_YN = 'N') , #{tgtTy} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , 'N') ON CONFLICT (TGT_SEQ, USER_SEQ, TGT_TY) DO UPDATE SET DEL_YN = CASE WHEN LIKES.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END RETURNING CASE WHEN LIKES.DEL_YN = 'N' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END AS LIKE_STATUS
